accountDropdown.name: List Posting Accounts
accountDropdown.url: https://app.simplepost.social/api/v1/accounts?pc_json_parser_type=transform&pc_json_parser_template={"accounts":"{{{ this.accounts.filter(a => !a.previewOnly).filter(a => a.credentialStatus?.state !== 'reauth_required').map(a => ({id: a.id, label: String(a.displayName || a.username || a.id).concat(' (', a.platform, ')')})) }}}"}

accountId.label: Social Account
accountId.help: Select the connected account this post is for.

message.label: Message
message.help: Enter or map the post text. Quotes, line breaks, and emoji are supported.

idempotencyKey.label: Deduplication Key
idempotencyKey.help: Map a unique source record ID with a workflow prefix, such as airtable:content:rec123. Use the same key when retrying that record.

scheduledFor.label: Scheduled For
scheduledFor.help: A future UTC timestamp in ISO 8601 format, such as 2030-05-01T14:00:00Z.

actions.name: Create Draft
actions.description: Saves a social post as a draft for review in SimplePost.

actions.name: Schedule Post
actions.description: Schedules a social post for a future date and time.
